newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAN shares rise after group net profit rise.
newsitem.headline: MAN shares rise after group net profit rise.

text.p: Shares in German industrial group MAN AG surged after the company reported a 21 percent increase in group net profit in 1995/96 to 330 million marks from 272 marks in 1994/95.
In early pre-bourse trade MAN shares were up 2.47 percent at 361.50 marks, compared to the overall IBIS DAX index down 0.05 percent at 2,553.14 points.
A dividend increase to 12 marks for 95/96 from 9.50 marks the previous year also helped boost the share.
Dealers said the MAN figures were as good as they had been expecting.
